hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"\(file_path\|notebook_path\)" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\2/p' | head -n 1 | tr '\134' '/' | sed 's#//*#/#g'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ ! -f "$d/xtask/Cargo.toml" ] || [ ! -e "$d/.git" ]; do p=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$p" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$p; done; grep -qs '^BUGABOO_CHECKOUT_ROLE=master' "$d/.env.local" && exit 0; cd "$d" && printf '%s' "$in" | cargo xtask hook post-edit
